afIssues.title: PR-string: CSV import interactive agent parity (streaming, feedback loop, kernel-validate)
afIssues.body:
CSV import agent (apps/hc/agent/hc-csv-import) adopts the interactive behavior built for hc-query-mutation. Goal: user observes streaming, shares feedback, loops on synthesis; validation authority moves fully to the kernel. Owner: adc.

APPROACH SETTLED WITH HARI (2026-07-09): harden -> unify, correctness first. Two hard constraints:
1. ZERO REGRESSION against the current CSV agent's effectiveness (it is very good; that bar is the acceptance gate, NOT just green CI). Reference the current one-shot flow's synthesis quality as the baseline to beat/hold.
2. The interactive/chat panel is TBD — needs real eng + product design before it is built. Do NOT scaffold a panel or file placeholder UI children until that design exists.

PHASING:
- Phase 1 (Harden) = the existing ladder ad.41.1 -> ad.41.2 -> ad.41.3, sequenced in that order. This closes the invariant #3 violation and is what makes safe interactive looping possible (every re-synthesis round revalidates through the real kernel, not the mirror).
- Phase 2 (Unify) = adopt packages/modules/agent-chat (useAgentChatSession) as the CSV surface — agent-chat's SECOND consumer, which is the legitimate substrate pressure per principles.md extraction-timing. Design-gated: produce an eng+product design brief AFTER Phase 1, then file children against the actual design. Streaming needs NO new substrate — runAgentTextStream + AgentStreamWireEvent<TTerminal> already exist and are app-agnostic; the 2026-07-07 transport doc already names CSV-import streaming as the deferred follow-on.

KEY SURVEY FINDING (no-regression pivot for ad.41.1): the client mirror is not only a save-time guard — it feeds the agent's IN-LOOP repair (MAX_VALIDATION_ATTEMPTS). So "retire the mirror" cannot be a straight delete; the kernel dry-run must be reachable INSIDE the synthesis/repair loop, and mirror checks demote to UX hints over the kernel verdict. Otherwise synthesis quality regresses.

SESSION MODEL (answers old open-Q #2): reference proves "session" is client-side only (useAgentChatSession); every turn incl. clarification answers + "continue" is a fresh server-minted run replaying text history; ledger is the durable per-run record. CSV import already half-does this (priorAnswers re-run loop).
afIssues.resolution: PHASE 1 + 2 BOT ROUNDS LANDED. PR #342, FINAL HEAD 60376564 (verified). Commits: ba2852fc(.1) 985e10ff(.2) 4ddfc40a(.3) 51475dd9(fmt) 272a35a2(bot-round-1: 2 P1) 60376564(CodeRabbit round-2: 1 Major ledger try/catch + serde optional + copy). Verified green each round: mise run check incl check:contracts, test:app 763/763 (15/15), cargo test -p arrusted-hc 117. adb coordinated (live): additional-reviewer pass AFTER round-2 (done, SHA sent), adc drives dual-MRR pinned to 60376564 with adb's invariant-#3 test (shape=prevents-silent-drop-only vs mirror=kernel-would-also-reject; trace deletion), adb reconciles as 3rd. Collision clear (ada ad.36/#354 in field_history; watch shared db.rs/server.rs disjoint hunks; merge order adb's: #341->#354->#342). Follow-up ad.41.5 (perf). Phase 2 (unify agent-chat) still design-gated. NOT merged (Hari). Env unstable — batching. Dual-MRR starting now.

afIssues.title: source-import validateFieldValueEnvelope: stop mutating input, defer FieldValue validity to the kernel
afIssues.body:
From the 2026-06-29 audit (Gap A / rec 2). SURVEY-CONFIRMED (2026-07-09):

LOCATION: packages/modules/source-import/workflow.ts:476-628 (validateFieldValueEnvelope), inside the WriteBoundImportPreview structural validator. Two callers, same file: :422 (staged values) and :465 (priorValues). Reachable in production via useSourceImportSession.

MUTATES ITS INPUT (the sharp edge — silent value rewrites, not just spurious rejects):
- :537 valueObject["value"] = normalized  (uppercased ISO country code)
- :549 valueObject["value"] = normalized  (uppercased ISO currency code)
- :619 moneyRate["currency"] = normalizedCurrency  (uppercased money_rate currency)

CORRECTNESS IT DUPLICATES (kernel owns authoritatively in validate_write kernel/src/validation.rs:842, enum-option at :1213/:1228, validate_apply_against_schema :632): envelope type/value shape (:491-512), per-field.type value-shape switch (:514-627), ISO-3166 alpha-2 country (:528-539), ISO-4217 currency (:540-551), enum option_set membership (:592-598), money_rate currency ISO (:600-621).

FIX: make it a pure kernel-verdict pass-through, OR an explicit kernel-confirmed normalization step (normalize where the kernel confirms the normalization is what apply would do) — not a silent rewriter living above the kernel. Depends on ad.41.1's dry-run bridge being reachable. Same no-regression gate: hold current synthesis effectiveness. (Body predates the agent branch; inherited but live. Outside boundary-lint scope.)
afIssues.resolution: COMMITTED 985e10ff (not pushed). Sign-off passed incl. orchestrator delta-review. Fix: pure kernel-verdict pass-through — validateFieldValueEnvelope removed entirely (mutation + duplicated FieldValue correctness). Delta-review CLEARED the no-regression concern at line level: normalization is not lost, it still happens upstream in import-classification.coerceImportFieldValue (uppercases iso_country/iso_currency at coercion, before preview); dedup/identity keys (lookupExternalKeyForImport) hash off the coercion-normalized value; sole consumer useSourceImportSession:583 is validate-only. So this deletes a redundant, drifting, silently-mutating second normalizer. Verified green: check:types, check:boundaries, test:app 757/757 hc + 15/15 tasks.

afIssues.title: CSV import: eager records-snapshot fetch before plan synthesis (perf)
afIssues.body:
Deferred from PR #342 bot round (qodo, apps/api/hc/agent/hc-csv-import/run.ts:~121). handleHcCsvImportRun fetches existing records for employee/position/org_assignment/lookup models BEFORE the agent returns a plan, to feed the kernel dry-run bridge (ad.41.1). This is broader than a post-plan scoped fetch: pre-run dry-run validation does not yet know which lookup/reference models the plan will actually touch, so it fetches all candidates.

Not a correctness issue and not fixed in #342 (would be a design change, not a quick scoping win). Options to evaluate: (a) move/factor snapshot loading to AFTER plan synthesis so only touched models are fetched; (b) plan-dependent lazy fetch inside the validator; (c) accept eager fetch if the record volumes are bounded. Assess cost against real tenant sizes before investing. Owner TBD; surfaced so it is not lost. Relates to ad.41.1 bridge.
